source: 《破碎大陆》序章 · 脚本书 (Claude Docs 698022a6-36e3-432b-850d-6247c01c505b)

lines.zh: 站上一座祭坛，选择你的角色
lines.en: Step onto an altar to choose your role
Lucifer · Leader
Beelzebub · Suppression
Belial · Control
Mammon · Ranged
This role is already taken

lines.zh: 全员就位，3 秒后开始
lines.en: Everyone is ready. Beginning in 3 seconds

lines.zh: 没人选的角色不参战，只在过场中出现
lines.en: Unchosen roles stay out of the fight and appear only in cutscenes
Prologue · A Thousand Years Ago
Armageddon
Michael · The Archangel
Who Is Like God
End of the Prologue
Returning you to your world
You received the Feather of Michael

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.zh: 起初，神造天地，又造众天使侍立在宝座前。
lines.en: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth, and the angels to stand before His throne.
lines.direction: Slow, reverent, like reading from an old book.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.zh: 众天使之中有一位最明亮的，名叫路西法，就是早晨之子。神将权与力都赐给他，使他在众天使之上。
lines.en: Among them was one brighter than all the rest, named Lucifer, the son of the morning. God gave him both Authority and Might, and set him above all the angels.
lines.direction: Warm on “brighter”; a small pause before “Authority and Might”.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.zh: 那时神说：将来必有一位子要来，众天使都当向他屈膝。
lines.en: Then God said: A Son shall come, and every angel shall bow the knee to Him.
lines.direction: Plain and weighty; God's words are not acted.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.zh: 路西法心里说：我要升到天上，我要高举我的宝座，在神众星以上。
lines.en: And Lucifer said in his heart: I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God.
lines.direction: Quieter, almost confiding; the quote is KJV Isaiah 14:13.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.zh: 于是他们聚集在一处，希伯来话叫作哈米吉多顿。
lines.en: And they gathered together into a place called in the Hebrew tongue Armageddon.
lines.direction: Land hard on “Armageddon”; KJV Revelation 16:16.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.zh: 那一脚落下的时候，路西法的意识离了身体，就是他的权。它化作一缕绿色的烟，遁入那将要合上的裂缝。
lines.en: When that foot came down, Lucifer's mind left his body — and that mind was his Authority. It became a thread of green smoke and fled into the closing rift.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.zh: 留在坑里的身体，连同他的力，归了那与神对立的。
lines.en: The body left in the pit, and his Might with it, passed to the one who stands against God.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: So Satan sank into the bottomless pit.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.zh: 米迦勒升到天上，身体渐渐消散，只剩下一片羽毛。
lines.en: Michael rose into heaven; his body faded away, until only a feather remained.

lines.zh: 第一波 · 移动与普攻
lines.en: Wave 1 · Movement and Attacks

lines.zh: 走上前去，用普通攻击击倒天使士兵
lines.en: Close in and strike down the Angel Soldiers
Wave 2 · Skills

lines.zh: 长按右键发动武器技能，按 F 释放角色技能
lines.en: Hold right-click for your weapon skill. Press F for your role skill
Wave 3 · The Throne

lines.zh: 潜行并按 F 释放大招。座天使的四只眼轮要在 3 秒内一起打碎
lines.en: Sneak and press F for your ultimate. Break all four of the Throne's eye-wheels within 3 seconds

lines.zh: 眼轮合上了，要一起打碎
lines.en: The eye-wheels have closed. Break them together
lines.when: 眼轮没在 3 秒内全碎，全部复原时

lines.en: Wave cleared
Push toward the center of the battlefield

lines.zh: 你倒下了，5 秒后在战场边缘重新加入
lines.en: You have fallen. Rejoining at the edge of the field in 5 seconds

lines.speaker: lucifer
lines.zh: 他要我们跪一个还没来的人。我不跪。
lines.en: He would have us kneel to one who has not yet come. I will not kneel.
lines.direction: Calm contempt, never shouting. A beat before “I will not kneel”, then flat and final.

lines.speaker: beelzebub
lines.en: Michael is just ahead.
lines.direction: Low, gravelly, unhurried. A warning stated like a fact, a little bored.

lines.speaker: lucifer
lines.en: Then we walk over him.
lines.direction: Quiet certainty, almost amused. No push on “walk”.

lines.speaker: belial
lines.en: And when we've won — whose is Heaven?
lines.direction: Silky and curious, half a smile. The dash is a breath.

lines.speaker: lucifer
lines.en: Ours.
lines.direction: One word, warm and sure. Not loud.

lines.speaker: mammon
lines.zh: 宝库也算在里面。记住你说的。
lines.en: The treasuries too. Remember you said it.
lines.direction: Dry, quick, transactional. “Remember you said it” like signing a contract.

lines.speaker: michael
lines.en: Who is like God!
lines.direction: A battle cry from high above: full voice and ringing, not angry — a challenge and a verdict at once. Hold “God”.

lines.speaker: michael
lines.zh: 路西法，你本是无所不备的，智慧充足，全然美丽。
lines.en: Lucifer — thou sealest up the sum, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.
lines.direction: Not a taunt. Grief and admiration at once, measured, each clause its own weight. KJV Ezekiel 28:12.

lines.speaker: michael
lines.en: The Lord rebuke thee.
lines.direction: Low and steady, almost a sigh. KJV Jude 9.

lines.speaker: michael
lines.en: Thine heart was lifted up because of thy beauty.
lines.direction: Sorrowful, a judgement read aloud. KJV Ezekiel 28:17.

lines.speaker: lucifer
lines.en: Scatter!
lines.direction: Sharp command, a leader's call; not panicked.

lines.speaker: beelzebub
lines.en: This fight is more than I can swallow.
lines.direction: Gravelly and unbothered, a little annoyed, like leaving a meal half-eaten. A short grunt before it.

lines.speaker: belial
lines.zh: 天上没有值得我死的东西。
lines.en: There's nothing in Heaven worth dying for.
lines.direction: Light, almost a shrug; amused even now.

lines.speaker: mammon
lines.en: I don't make losing trades.
lines.direction: Brisk and decided, already walking away; a merchant closing the ledger.

lines.speaker: antichrist
lines.en: I will return.
lines.direction: Lucifer's voice, but something else is speaking through it: slow, almost tender, certain. Post: pitch down 3 semitones, a whispered take layered under it, a large dark reverb.

lines.speaker: michael
lines.en: That day is coming.
lines.direction: Quiet and tired, looking down. Not triumphant: a prophecy stated plainly.

lines.en: Feather of Michael
A past like a dream, yet no passing smoke.
He shall return.
